title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Mon Nov 23)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Mon, Nov 23

Rivalry week opens short-handed: Ohio State likely won't get a veteran back for Michigan, Clemson is down to its third QB, UCLA's QB got good X-ray news, and there's still no word on Indiana's No. 16 WR 🧵👇

🩹 JA'KOBI JACKSON | Ohio State | SR | #616 RB

Unlikely to be available against Michigan, per CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz (via RotoWire).

That keeps Bo Jackson | SO, 4⭐ | #11 RB as the starter, with Isaiah West | SO, 3⭐ | #192 RB behind him.

🩹 NICK MARSH | Indiana | JR, 4⭐ | #16 WR

Thanked fans for their prayers Sunday after the hit at Washington. His status for Purdue isn't clear yet (via Heavy).

✅ Ty Dieffenbach | UCLA | SR, 3⭐ | #519 QB: X-rays were negative, more tests to come (via UCLA Wire).

🩹 Christopher Vizzina | Clemson | SR, 4⭐ | #587 QB: "definitely" out for South Carolina, per Dabo Swinney. Trent Pearman | SR | #716 QB starts again.

❓ Tyler Brown | Clemson | SR, 3⭐ | #410 WR: Swinney is "very hopeful" (via The State).

Who worries you most? 👇
